name: Ugly Duckling
source:
"Hmm, If you want a fight I'll give it to you, you impotent bastard!!"

A grey duckling that escaped from a certain castle.
He's coming along on the journey with Thumbelina as emergency rations.
He's exceedingly frank and loves women. He often talks non-stop about indecent topics.
